fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, so no owner took part. The planner read the request queue (internal/api/request.go, internal/daemon/requests.go), the change set open body (internal/changeset/body.go), the event hook (internal/api/daemon_events.go) and ship open-pr (internal/api/ship_openpr.go). It raised four choices to the arbiter in one question: which intent to serve with no open milestone, where the ref lives, the length limit, and what to do about decision workflows-are-the-rules (PR #353, not landed). The arbiter ruled in Decision request-ref-shape: serve milestone-25. Store the ref as an optional field on the change set's open entry, under a new entry format version, and also on the request. Limit it to 2048 bytes after trimming and validate nothing else. Escape it wherever it is shown: Go-quoted in human output, a plain string in JSON, an escaped inline code span in the PR body. Don't link the unlanded PR #353 decision. The planner then split the work into five leaves: request ref, change set ref, plan run carries ref, event payload ref and PR body ref.
fields.title: Plan interview: requests carry an opaque ref (autonomous)
